steps.name: Given I am on the Init page
When I set Region select field
When I set "lucky-liger-8" into Environment Code input field
Then I can connect to the Environment
When I switch to the web view context
And I click on "Sign In" button
And I switch to native view context
Then I wait for page to load
Then The Worklist page is open
Verify WO page: Mobile Work Execution
Then WO page is "Mobile Work Execution"
Then I click on "START ICON" button
Then I click on "START WORK" button
Verify work order status: In Progress
Then The status of the work Order is in "In Progress"
Then I click on "SEE MORE" button
Then I wait for page to load
Then I click on "SEE LESS" button
Then I wait for page to load
Then I click on "PAUSE ICON" button
Then I click on "PAUSE WORK ORDER" button
